captions.detailed: A 3D model of a Newtonian reflector telescope mounted on a motorized equatorial mount. The assembly features a white cylindrical main optical tube with a black rack-and-pinion focuser, supported by black mounting rings clamped onto a dovetail saddle. The telescope is supported on a black tripod base with three legs and a central spreader tray. The equatorial mount includes a continuous right-ascension axis, a revolute declination axis, and a counterweight shaft with cylindrical counterweights.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Newtonian reflector telescope on a motorized equatorial mount. The telescope should feature a white cylindrical optical tube with a black focuser, clamped onto a black equatorial mount with adjustable axes, supported by a sturdy black tripod with three legs and a central tray.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod using three angled cylinders for the legs, joined to a central hub cylinder and a thin disc for the accessory tray. Build the equatorial mount head using a combination of rotated boxes and cylinders to form the polar axis, declination housing, counterweight shaft, and dovetail saddle. Model the telescope optical tube as a hollow white cylinder, and add black mounting rings, a cylindrical focuser assembly, and cylindrical counterweights. Assemble the components using relative transformations and define joints for the right-ascension and declination axes.
